newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers ease, at $10-$15/T below S.Korea.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers ease, at $10-$15/T below S.Korea.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes fell with sellers slashing levels to attract buyers, traders said on Wednesday.
Bunker 380-cst was widely quoted between $92-$100 per tonne with some independents even indicating below $90 a tonne, traders said. Bunker 180 was notional at around $100-$102.
Prices in Singapore are very competitive, at $10-$15 below South Korean quotes and on par with levels in Fujiarah, traders said.
"The low prices may trigger a price recovery but sentiment is still weak," said a trader. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
